requests.description: Full-body pixel-art BLOODRIDGE CHAMPION, the war chief's feared RIGHT HAND and elite Warden-killer, not a common Skirmisher. Native128x128, full figure about120px tall, same stature as the supplied WARDEN reference. Low top-down three-quarter southwest battle view facing left. Use the reference's exact rotted sepia/ash cloth, aged bronze, dark values and deliberate pixel detail; do not copy its body, pose, shield or costume. Keep the BLOODRIDGE RACE: deep ragged burial hood, face in shadow with clear ember eyes and gaunt ashen cheek, desiccated ash skin with thin molten fissures, bandaged limbs, torn funerary linen. Lean powerful long-limbed heroic adult, small head, commanding shoulders, threatening high-status silhouette. Not bulky or chibi. CHAMPION IDENTITY1: a visibly MASSIVE CORRODED BRONZE RIGHT FOREARM graft, shoulder to fist crossed by exposed tension ribs and ember skin-metal seams, substantially larger than ordinary forearm and readable at game size. That augmented arm grips a heavy broad HOOKED executioner's KHOPESH, one unmistakable C-hook blade, held LOW across his front at hip level with the other hand steadying the hilt. Upright planted legs, broad but light torn shoulder mantle on opposite shoulder, exposed scarred ribcage, long divided burial tabard ending below knees. Power concentrated in grafted arm and heavy blade, not whole-body armour. Entire body, both feet and entire weapon inside128x128 with3px transparent margins, no cropped tips, no background. Hood remains present. Upper-left light. Corroded desiccated materials, restrained ember seams, no neon. No shield, staff, crown, antlers, skull shoulder trophies, full plate suit or clean assassin outfit.
